changelog:
Initial release of cashclaw-social-media

- Create and manage content calendars with platform-native strategies for Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and TikTok.
- Automatically write platform-specific posts using proven templates and content rules.
- Track and report on analytics with detailed monthly performance breakdowns.
- Support for a range of service tiers, from calendar-only to full analytics and multi-platform packages.
- Provide detailed best practices, post templates, scheduling guidance, and calendar deliverables for all major platforms.
summary: Creates content calendars, writes platform-specific posts, tracks analytics, and manages social media presence across Instagram, Twitter/X, LinkedIn, Faceboo...
